title: The vitals grid at 390 px starts scrolled so a clipped narrow column shows on the left, and today's saved weight is missing from the NEW column
evidence: Seen in the PR 1508 shots at 390 px: the grid opens scrolled so a clipped column shows on the left (a "lia" fragment of a sys/dia placeholder), and the NEW column shows "—" for weight though today's weight is saved. Older behaviour, not from PR 1508. (H79)
